name: exp-card
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Every monster kill has a chance to drop an Exp Card, bound to the killer for the standard pickup window. Using the card grants a percentage of the exp needed for the next level (base and job), so it stays meaningful at any level. Streamlines offline levelling without touching per-mob drop tables.

settings.label: Drop chance (0.01% units)
settings.description: Odds an Exp Card drops from any given monster kill, in 0.01% units. 100 = 1%, 1000 = 10%. Applied on top of stock drops; the mob's own table is unchanged.

settings.label: Base exp per card (% of next level)
settings.description: Base exp granted on card use, as a percentage of the player's current next-level requirement. 5 = 5% of the exp to next base level -- always meaningful, at every level.

settings.label: Job exp per card (% of next level)
settings.description: Job exp granted on card use, as a percentage of the player's current next-job-level requirement. 5 = 5% of the exp to next job level.
